entries.4d8ccaa7c17cfe0c: This business provides contract processing of aircraft engine parts, gas turbine parts and other various metal products, and contract surface treatment of aircraft engine parts and gas turbine parts. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥9,906 million, up 18.8% from the previous year. Increased demand for aircraft, growth in demand for defense equipment, and higher orders for gas turbine parts linked to rising electricity demand contributed to this. The company carries this out at its sites in Okayama, Narita, Kasugai, Komaki and others.
entries.5752e72f3b77c200: The core of its strategy, under a structure in which contract processing accounts for 97.0% of revenue, is to meet growing demand for gas turbine parts, defense equipment and aircraft engine parts by expanding production capacity, while promoting sales of its own products (the digital servo press, chromium-free paint and mixing and melting machine) and gradually reducing its dependence on major customers.
